name: skill-structure-check
description: Structure and rule-text check for skills/ub-mode/SKILL.md.

command:
import re, sys
from pathlib import Path
name, phrases = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:]
text = Path("skills/%s/SKILL.md" % name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
m = re.match(r"---\n(.*?)\n---\n", text, re.S)
assert m, "missing frontmatter"
fm = m.group(1)
assert re.search(r"^name: %s$" % re.escape(name), fm, re.M), "frontmatter name must be " + name
assert re.search(r'^description: ".+"$', fm, re.M), "description must be one quoted line"
assert re.search(r"^version: \d+\.\d+\.\d+$", fm, re.M), "version missing"
for marker in ("**Purpose**", "**Trigger**", "Last updated: "):
    assert marker in text, "missing " + marker
assert not re.search(r"[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+\.[\w.]+|\+\d[\d ().-]{8,}\d|\(?\d{3}\)?[ .-]\d{3}[ .-]\d{4}", text), "email or phone found"
for p in phrases:
    assert p in text, "rule text missing: " + p
print("OK: " + name)
read `.metrics/dry.edn`: **no** `:candidates` entry with `:score` **≥ 0.8** (dryer exits `0` even when pairs meet the threshold)
exit `0`; cover the uncovered, kill the survivors, delete dead code
Keep a log of every action and the reason
keep the main thread small; bulk work elsewhere with a summary
Find what is safe to remove; uncommitted work waits for a human decision
Commit often in small ordered commits; each states **why**, **what**, and **how proved**
